package services

import (
	"context"

	"go-net-http-auth-base/internal/domain"
)

type {{resources}}Service struct {
	repo domain.{{Resources}}Repository
}

func New{{Resources}}Service(repo domain.{{Resources}}Repository) domain.{{Resources}}Service {
	return &{{resources}}Service{repo: repo}
}

func (s *{{resources}}Service) GetByUUID(ctx context.Context, uuid string) (*domain.{{Resource}}, error) {
	return s.repo.FindByUUID(ctx, uuid)
}

func (s *{{resources}}Service) Create(ctx context.Context, dto domain.Create{{Resource}}DTO) (*domain.{{Resource}}, error) {
	// TODO: Map the DTO fields and apply the business rules.
	entity := domain.{{Resource}}{}

	return s.repo.Create(ctx, entity)
}

func (s *{{resources}}Service) Update(ctx context.Context, uuid string, dto domain.{{Resource}}UpdateDTO) (*domain.{{Resource}}, error) {
	entity, err := s.repo.FindByUUID(ctx, uuid)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// TODO: Apply only the fields set in the DTO (pointer fields).
	return s.repo.Update(ctx, *entity)
}

func (s *{{resources}}Service) Delete(ctx context.Context, uuid string) error {
	return s.repo.Delete(ctx, uuid)
}
